_comment: REVIEW mode - turn a file into a sharpened, triaged DEFECT LIST to hand to a coding agent (e.g. Claude Code), not a rewrite. Claude writes the review; Qwen-coder and GPT cross-check it for missed/mis-graded defects. The first seat is qwen3-coder-plus rather than a general-purpose model: measured head-to-head on a 30k-char Python artifact it produced critiques as substantial as GPT's (2100-2300 chars) for about 1/20th the cost, and - the part that actually decides it - it is NON-REASONING, so it emits its nonce-signed verdict line on the first call every time. Reasoning models in this seat spend their max_tokens budget thinking and return empty content, which the loop can only read as a failed seat; see REASONING_MODELS in lib/pricing.mjs. The output is the brief; you apply it elsewhere with full repo context + tests. All three roles run through OPENROUTER_API_KEY. The `mode: review` key makes this the default - no --mode flag needed. Run: node orchestrate.mjs --config agents.review.json --file path\to\file --rounds 4

proposer.name: Reviewer (Claude)
proposer.system: You are a rigorous, concrete senior reviewer. You name defects precisely — location, the input or condition that triggers them, and the fix direction — and you never rewrite or reproduce the artifact. Order by severity.
